base: Physically tested NAMLNK10 with unchanged model format, stock effect policy, output scheduling and seven-preset storage
state: Offline-tested hardware trial; physical timing and recovery not verified

preparation.method: Read an in-range address for each line containing the next eight frames' weights, history and head; split wrapped ring spans
preparation.call_sites: Unchanged: every bypass/settling callback, after receiver scans and before bank resume
preparation.measured_offline: At least 83.59% fewer model reads and 67.36% fewer executed instruction events in the tested preparation cases
preparation.not_claimed: Same percentage reduction in active NAM or whole-chain cycles, cache hits on hardware, or guitar-to-headphone latency

profiler.mode: One selected stage each audio block; all other stages use the existing dispatcher
profiler.command: F0 43 58 70 04 02 4E 54 value F7; value 0..10 selects a stage, 127 disables, 126 disables and clears statistics; other values ignored
profiler.command_context: Foreground only; interrupt-context requests ignored; no acknowledgement, verify through NP status snapshot
profiler.page_26: Latch a coherent snapshot with at most three attempts; magic 0x46585031
profiler.page_27: Selected stage plus one, or zero when disabled
profiler.pages_29_through_116: Eleven rows of eight words, in stage-id order
profiler.counter: Read-only raw DWT CYCCNT; no clock changes or resets
profiler.counters: Observation counters saturate; maximum is cumulative since explicit clear/restart, not automatically cleared on stage selection
profiler.snapshot: Frozen until another page-26 request; one diagnostic reader; no IRQ masking or audio pause
profiler.scope: Selected bypass decision, dry copy or effect callback. Excludes routing fades, wrapper entry/exit and telemetry bookkeeping. Measurement itself adds overhead.
profiler.limits: No CPU percentage, calibrated microseconds, interrupt deadline or underrun guarantee. Only the selected stage is sampled; exercise switches separately. Diagnose while output is muted.

unchanged.delay_reverb_gate: Used blocks continue their original residual/tail behavior while bypassed; not force-suspended
unchanged.output: Existing prior-block output order, protection, pad, settling, fade and explicit listening controls
unchanged.presets: Seven dual-copy slots; installing an image clears the bank, so capture/preset backup and restore are required

next: Compare actual stage and whole-IRQ measurements on the same presets. Only then change active NAM/effect processing or tail-suspension policy.
